spans.s:
तेज m. sharpness;
 N. of a man.

ते॑जस् n. sharpness, edge, (pungent) heat, fire, light,
radiance, lustre, beauty, vigour, strength, energy, esp. male energy,
concr.
[]
semen virile;
 violence, fierceness;
 power, authority,
dignity.
ते॑जस्काम a. desiring strength, energy, or dignity.
ते॑जस्वन्त् a. burning, shining, splendid, beautiful.
तेजस्विता f. ˚त्व n. abstr. to seq.

ते॑जिष्ठ (superl.) most sharp, hot, shining, bright,
strong, or violent. n. adv.
तेजोद्वय n. the two lights (sun and moon).

तेजोम॑य f. ई consisting of fire, light, or splendour;
shining, bright, clear.
तेजोमूर्ति a. whose form is light.
तेजोराशि m. nothing but (lit. a heap of) splendour.

तेजोवृत्त^1 n. noble or dignified behaviour.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: cf. MW, also alph. order.
